canonical_project: Equinix SY10x / Grand Avenue Data Centre Expansion, Rosehill
notes: NSW Planning Portal approved SSD-53338465 on 2024-12-16 for expansion of an existing Rosehill data centre at 8 Grand Avenue; SEARs identify the applicant as Equinix Hyperscale 2 (SY10), and listings identify the resulting SY10x facility at about 28 MW.
